title: "Acquire SWISSIMAGE orthophotos"
description: "Discover, download and mosaic intersecting orthophoto tiles."

<div class="toolbox-kind">Recipe · implementation pending</div>

## Intended workflow

```text
polygon or bbox
  → discover intersecting STAC items
  → inspect available assets and dates
  → download selected tiles
  → mosaic when needed
  → optionally crop or mask
  → export raster
```

This recipe should reuse the generic [geo.admin STAC](geoadmin-stac.qmd) discovery pattern and the [raster](../snippets/raster.qmd) mosaic/crop operations. Catalog identifiers, asset layouts and licensing must be verified before executable acquisition code is added.
